terms: 50% non-refundable deposit secures your date; the balance is due before gallery delivery.
Rescheduling with at least 7 days' notice is free. With less notice: R500 fee; the deposit transfers.
Outdoor shoots include a backup indoor location. Severe weather means a free reschedule.
Full gallery delivery: 7 to 14 days for every package. Social includes a 48-hour sneak peek of 10 images.
Travel within 25km of Kempton Park is included. Additional travel is confirmed before booking.
Personal use licence with every package. The Social package includes a commercial licence.
